title: Rice straw to renewable hydrogen: comparative life cycle assessment of gasification and dark fermentation for hydrogen production in Thailand
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,920-930
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01551K, Paper
Hafsa Mehmood, Haseeb Akbar, Shabbir H. Gheewala
